summary: Shared ontology/lexicon preamble for the MTT pilot files (Required by Book_Homonymy, Book_veridical, Book_Event_Adv, Book_Inter_Sub, Book_Multi): CN := Set with 30 common-noun type constants; a 17-arrow subtyping hierarchy (Man/Woman >-> Human >-> Animal >-> Object, Swede >-> Scandinavian, Bank >-> Institution, etc.) rendered as Axiom-declared functions registered as Coq Coercions; polymorphic generalized quantifiers some/all/no over CN (with A/each synonyms); individual constants John, George, Mary, Helen. The file's namesake construct — Book as a Sigma/record type over the dot-type PhyInfo (phy :> Phy, info :> Info) with Pustejovsky qualia (Formal/Telic/Agent) — is present only inside a comment block (lines 6-16) and is not active code. Zero theorems; pure signature.

sources.citation: Chatzikyriakidis, S. & Luo, Z. (2014). Natural Language Inference in Coq. Journal of Logic, Language and Information 23(4):441-480.
Luo, Z. (2012). Common Nouns as Types. LACL 2012, LNCS 7351.
Chatzikyriakidis, S. & Luo, Z. (2020). Formal Semantics in Modern Type Theories. Wiley/ISTE.
Pustejovsky, J. (1995). The Generative Lexicon. MIT Press. (qualia structure, via Luo's dot-types)

evidence: grep finds 0 Theorem/Lemma/Corollary/Fact/Proposition and 0 Admitted in the 42-line file: it is signature-only, so no headline claim of the source (e.g. C&L 2014's FraCaS inferences via subtyping) is established here
the active declarations reproduce C&L 2014's Coq preamble essentially verbatim: CN := Set, Axiom+Coercion subtyping arrows, the polymorphic some/all/no quantifiers
the dot-type Book record with qualia structure — the construct the filename advertises — is commented out at lines 6-16 and never re-established
all 17 Axioms have Set-valued function types (coercion witnesses) and all Parameters are type/individual constants, so per rubric 3(a) none carries propositional content: propositional_axioms = 0
simplifications: CN := Set identifies Luo's cn universe with Coq's Set (the source's own Coq move; the full theory uses setoids)
coercive subtyping simulated by Coq's Coercion mechanism without coherence checking
omissions: all inference theorems (the NLI examples live in the five Book_*.v files that Require this preamble)
MTT machinery beyond the lexicon: no Pi/Sigma CN operations, no adjectives, no dependent event types

determination_rationale: This is a shared signature/lexicon preamble (infrastructure Required by five Book_*.v pilots) with zero theorems, so under rubric section 4 it cannot evidence any determination of MTT semantics — verdicts about the theory must be carried by the theorem-bearing companion files. Its one substantive datum is negative: the qualia Book record over the dot-type PhyInfo was written and then commented out, matching Luo's published position that dot-types are not Sigma-types and require native support Coq lacks (class iv).

artifact_classes.description: CN := Set collapses the source's common-noun universe into a Coq universe of types (types-as-values for CNs is the theory's point, but the setoid structure of Luo's cn is dropped)
no native coercive subtyping: simulated by Axiom function constants + Coq Coercion with no coherence guarantee; no native dot-types: the Phy*Info Book record with qualia is abandoned in a comment

notes: Record produced by the batch audit sweep of 2026-09-05; the file predates the atlas zero-axiom discipline (17 Axioms + 34 Parameter constants, all signature-only with no propositional content).
